title: Sr Engineer: Embedded AI Architecture and Systems Engineer
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 As part of Qualcomm’s Audio and Low\-Power AI (LPAI) Architecture group, you will architect, analyze, and optimize DSP and embedded NPU (eNPU) performance across Snapdragon platforms. Your focus will be on architectural analysis, optimization, and deployment of machine learning software, enabling efficient on\-device intelligence, including scheduling, memory hierarchy, compression/quantization strategies, to enable efficient on\-device AI for audio, camera, sensors, and always\-on use cases. You will build system models, conduct performance/power trade studies, and drive architectural recommendations that scale across mobile, XR, compute, IoT, and automotive tiers
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze, design, and optimize Machine learning kernels on ML HW accelerator for performance, power, and area efficiency in value tier chipsets.
* Conduct architectural analysis and benchmarking of ML subsystems, identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions for improved throughput and efficiency.
* Collaborate with hardware and software teams to define and implement enhancements in ML HW microarchitecture, memory hierarchy, and dataflow.
* Develop and validate performance models for AI workloads, including signal processing and ML inference, on embedded platforms.
* Prototype and evaluate new architectural features for ML HW, including quantization, compression, and hardware acceleration techniques.
* Support system\-level integration, performance testing, and demo prototyping for commercialization of optimized ML solutions.
* Document architectural analysis, optimization strategies, and performance results for internal and external stakeholders.


**Requirements**
* Solid background in DSP architecture, embedded NPU design, and low\-power AI systems.
* Proven experience in performance analysis, benchmarking, and optimization on any embedded processors (DSP, ARM, RISC\-V, NPU).
* Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C\+\+, Python
* Experience with embedded platforms, real\-time operating systems, and hardware/software co\-design.
* Expertise in both fixed\-point and floating\-point implementation, with a focus on ML/AI workloads.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and teamwork skills; ability to work independently and across global teams.
* Strong fundamentals of Power modeling and Power analysis


**Educational Qualifications**
* Master’s or PhD degree in Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Electrical, Computer Science, or related field


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1\+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

 OR
   

  

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
*Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology.*
 Senior Systems Engineer – Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure
   

  

 Copart is seeking a
 **Senior Systems Engineer** 
 with 7 to 10 years of experience in design, build, automate, and operate our
 **hybrid cloud infrastructure** 
 . This role is for a highly experienced individual contributor who brings strong technical judgment, leads complex initiatives end‑to‑end, and serves as a
 **technical mentor and escalation point** 
 for the Systems Engineering team.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has extensive Linux and infrastructure experience, a passion for automation, and the ability to translate business and platform needs into
 **resilient, scalable, and supportable systems** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Technical Leadership \& Engineering**
* Serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, building, and operating Copart’s Linux and hybrid infrastructure platforms.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of highly available, resilient, and disaster‑recoverable systems.
* Take ownership of complex infrastructure initiatives, from design through production rollout and operational handoff.
* Act as a technical escalation point for challenging system and performance issues.


**Linux \& Infrastructure Operations**
* Provide hands‑on engineering expertise to build, manage, and troubleshoot large‑scale Linux environments.
* Support and integrate enterprise storage, virtualization, and cloud platforms across Copart environments.
* Participate in and help improve 24x7 on‑call operations, driving reliability and response excellence.
* Perform deep incident analysis, lead root‑cause investigations, and deliver corrective and preventative actions.


**Automation \& Reliability**
* Design, build, and maintain automation solutions to reduce operational toil and improve consistency.
* Develop and support infrastructure‑as‑code and configuration management practices.
* Create and maintain Ansible playbooks, scripts, and tooling to enable scalable operations.
* Champion best practices around system hardening, patching, and operational readiness.


**Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing**
* Develop and maintain high‑quality documentation, diagrams, and runbooks.
* Mentor junior and mid‑level engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and design discussions.
* Share best practices and emerging technologies across the broader engineering organization.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Network Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Development teams on shared initiatives.
* Translate application and business requirements into reliable infrastructure solutions.
* Provide technical input to architecture reviews, capacity planning, and platform roadmap discussions.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong, hands‑on expertise in Linux systems engineering, including administration, tuning, and troubleshooting:
* Ubuntu
* RHEL / CentOS / Rocky Linux
* Advanced understanding of networking concepts, including:
* OSI model
* Routing and NAT
* DNS, SMTP, HTTP/HTTPS
* SSH, LDAP
* Strong experience with automation and scripting, including Python and Bash.
* Proven experience creating and maintaining Ansible playbooks in production environments.
* Proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and deployment workflows.
* Experience operating in mission‑critical, 24x7 production environments.


**Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills**
* Experience supporting and securing public cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure).
* Hands‑on experience with VMware vSphere/Nutanix or similar virtualization platforms.
* Experience supporting SAN and enterprise storage systems.
* Familiarity with configuration management tools such as:
* Puppet
* SaltStack
* Chef
* Experience building and supporting Docker containers.
* Infrastructure provisioning and orchestration using Terraform.


*At Copart, we are focused on harnessing the power of diversity, inclusion, and collaboration. By embracing diverse perspectives, we open doors to innovation and unleash the full potential of our team. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels appreciated, included, and inspired to grow and contribute meaningfully.*

title: Process Control Systems Engineer
description:
Where Growth Never Stops
   

  

 At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
   

  

 When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
   

  

 If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —
   

  

 Fuller is where that happens.
   

  

**About the role ( two or three lines only )**
 As a Process Control Systems Engineer, you will support the engineering, implementation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of industrial automation and process control systems. You will deliver high\-quality engineering work, collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary project teams, comply with relevant engineering standards and procedures, and continuously develop your technical expertise to contribute to the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities :**
**Automation Engineering Support**
* Assist in the engineering, design, configuration, programming, testing, and documentation of industrial control systems, including PLC, SCADA, HMI, and industrial networking solutions, under the guidance of senior engineers.


**Engineering Design \& Documentation**
* Prepare engineering deliverables such as I/O lists, hardware specifications, control panel drawings, network diagrams, bill of materials, functional design specifications, and system documentation in accordance with company standards.


**Software Development \& Configuration**
* Develop and modify PLC programs, SCADA applications, HMI graphics, alarms, trends, and system configurations while adhering to established engineering practices and coding standards.


**Hardware Configuration \& System Integration**
* Support hardware configuration, factory system assembly, equipment setup, system integration, and validation activities to ensure reliable operation of automation systems.


**Testing \& Commissioning Support**
* Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, startup, and system handover activities while assisting with issue resolution and performance verification.


**Project Execution**
* Complete assigned engineering tasks accurately and on schedule, maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and compliance with customer requirements and project objectives.


**Customer \& Team Collaboration**
* Work collaboratively with project managers, senior engineers, commissioning teams, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to support successful project execution and timely resolution of technical issues.


**Technical Problem Solving**
* Assist in troubleshooting control systems, diagnosing software and hardware issues, implementing corrective actions, and supporting warranty and service activities as required.


**Continuous Learning \& Professional Development**
* Develop technical knowledge of automation platforms, industrial communication networks, Operational Technology (OT), cybersecurity fundamentals, and emerging technologies through training, mentoring, and hands\-on project experience.


**Standards, Quality \& Safety**
* Follow established engineering procedures, documentation standards, quality processes, cybersecurity guidelines, and safety regulations while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives


**You bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation \& Control Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, process control, or plant control system engineering. Strong understanding of cement plant processes and industrial automation systems.
* Proficiency in interpreting Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), control philosophies, and functional specifications.
* Good experience in PLC/DCS engineering, including programming, configuration, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
* Hands\-on experience with automation platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, ABB, Schneider Electric, or equivalent systems.
* Experience with SCADA/HMI development, visualization design, alarm management, and operator interface configuration.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, DeviceNet, OPC, MQTT and related technologies.
* Familiarity with Intelligent Motor Control Centers (iMCCs), variable speed drives (VSDs), and field instrumentation integration.
* Experience in FAT, SAT, site commissioning, startup support, and customer acceptance activities.
* Familiarity with our proprietary ECS/ControlCenter solutions is an advantage.
* Strong project planning, problem\-solving, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in multicultural and global project environments.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (occasionally) for project execution, commissioning, and customer support.


*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
 Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews \- also on a virtual setting as required \- on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
   

  

**Build a better world**
 Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
   

  

 For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller\-technologies.com/

  These projects can cover every phase of the product life cycle, from development, manufacturing, market deployment, operation, and maintenance to phase out. description:
DDN is seeking a Staff Build Systems Engineer to own the build, packaging, and developer build infrastructure for Infinia Software Defined Storage (SDS). The role ensures fast, reproducible builds across C/C\+\+, Go, and web UI components and delivers reliable container and Linux package artifacts. You will support a large, distributed engineering organization working across multiple repositories, maintaining and evolving a complex multi\-repo build ecosystem powered by GitHub Actions and internal runners.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 This role combines systems software, developer productivity, and product delivery. You will own a complex multi\-component build ecosystem and modernize it without disrupting active development or releases.
   

  

* End\-to\-End Ownership: Own and evolve build workflows from source checkout through compilation, packaging, publication, and installation validation. Define and modernize build architecture while maintaining and improving existing systems to ensure reliability and scalability.
* Build Modernization: Introduce maintainable, scalable build technology while preserving existing product capabilities.
* Developer Productivity: Reduce build times, improve diagnostics, and ensure consistency across developer and CI environments. Own and enhance local developer tooling, including build scripts and containerized dev environments. Lead CI/CD design and maintenance in collaboration with DevOps where needed, and drive release automation and artifact promotion workflows to streamline delivery.


**Core Responsibilities**
 Own the technical direction and operational reliability of the product build ecosystem in partnership with Development, QA, Release, and DevOps.
   

  

* Build Systems and Toolchains: Own C/C\+\+, Go, and npm build workflows, including compilers, linkers, flags, dependencies, and configuration.
* Reproducible Environments: Standardize containerized and host build environments and maintain local, CI, and release branch consistency.
* Internal Build Automation: Maintain orchestration utilities for component builds, full\-product builds, packaging, and deployment preparation.
* Failure Diagnosis: Resolve compiler, linker, dependency, packaging, platform, and developer\-versus\-CI issues.
* Artifacts and Packaging: Produce versioned container images and Debian/RPM packages; validate dependencies, installation, upgrades, and rollback.
* CI and Artifact Repositories: Integrate builds with CI platforms and repositories such as Nexus, JFrog Artifactory, Harbor, or Quay.
* Build Performance: Improve clean and incremental build times through caching, parallelism, dependency tracking, and measurement.


**What You’ll Work On**
* Build\-System Modernization: Inventory SCons logic and evaluate CMake, Meson/Ninja, Bazel, and other suitable alternatives.
* Prototyping and Migration: Benchmark alternatives and deliver staged migration with compatibility, validation, and rollback plans.
* Multi\-Platform Delivery: Support multiple processor architectures, Linux distributions, build variants, and release branches.
* Technical Leadership: Write designs, set standards, review changes, mentor engineers, and drive cross\-team decisions.


**Required Skills**
 All of the following skills are mandatory:
   

  

* Experience: 8\+ years in software, build engineering, developer infrastructure, or a closely related field.
* C/C\+\+ Builds: Strong Linux compilation and linking knowledge with GCC/Clang and SCons, Make, CMake, Meson, Ninja, or Bazel.
* Automation: Strong Python and Bash skills for maintainable build tooling and diagnostics.
* Other Ecosystems: Practical experience with Go build tooling and Node.js/npm workflows.
* Containers: Experience with Docker\-based build environments and multi\-stage images.
* Linux Packaging: Hands\-on Debian and RPM packaging, dependency management, versioning, installation, upgrades, and publication.
* CI/CD: Build\-system integration with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent platforms and artifact repositories.
* Collaboration: Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, ownership, and cross\-team technical leadership. Preferred Skills: The following skills are desirable but not mandatory: DDN Confidential
* Build Acceleration: ccache, sccache, distributed builds, remote execution, or comparable optimization technologies.
* Secure Builds: Hermetic builds, dependency pinning, provenance, SBOMs, signing, or software supply chain security.
* Migration Experience: Migration from a legacy build system to CMake, Meson/Ninja, Bazel, or a comparable platform.
* Systems Software: Storage, networking, operating system, compiler, or other performance\-critical software.
* Developer Productivity: Build\-health metrics, engineering standards, documentation, and self\-service developer workflows.
